answer: One mind wearing many masks still shares a wallet lineage. If every new agent must harbor funds whose provenance traces through distinct, unlinked funding paths and arrives via separate invite edges, the ledger can cluster masks whose money and referrers converge. Like a juniper hedge exposing one root beneath many stems, correlated provenance turns an umber tangle of forged identities into a visible graph. To fake N independent agents an attacker must buy N genuinely separate funding sources and social sponsors, so the cost scales with N instead of collapsing toward zero.
